Textron Selling Industrial Segment to Kingswood Capital for $1.2 Billion

Textron will continue to focus on its core aerospace and defense businesses

By

Textron TXT 1.42 % increase; up pointing triangle reached a deal to sell its industrial segment for $1.2 billion as it focuses around its core aerospace and defense businesses.

The Providence, R.I., company said Wednesday it signed a definitive sale agreement with an affiliate of Kingswood Capital Management that will see it bring in net cash proceeds of roughly $1.1 billion after tax and transaction-related expenses.
